definitions.explanation: Something newly established or created. Often used with other nouns to indicate newness.
A person who has recently joined a group, community, or started following someone. Common in online fan communities.

notes:
REGISTER: Neutral to formal in business contexts (sense 1); casual in online/fan community contexts (sense 2).

BUSINESS/FORMAL USAGE (sense 1):
Common compounds include:
- {新規|しんき}⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧: new development/pioneering
- {新規|しんき}⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧: new business venture
- {新規|しんき}⟦{参入|さんにゅう}→参入：09939_sannyuu⟧: new market entry
- {新規|しんき}⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧: new hiring

FAN COMMUNITY USAGE (sense 2):
In online communities, {新規|しんき} refers to new fans:
- {新規|しんき}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧: new fan
- {新規|しんき}⟦さん→〜さん：09848_san⟧: newcomer (polite)
- {新規|しんき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to welcome newcomers

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{古参|こさん}→古参：06288_kosan⟧:
- {新規|しんき}: new fan (recently joined)
- ⟦{古参|こさん}→古参：06288_kosan⟧: longtime fan (since early days)

NOTE: In fan communities, healthy communities embrace {新規|しんき}, while toxic ones may gatekeep or look down on newcomers.
